strengths: Multiplication is the physical shot quantity; three stages progress through tens/ones, hundreds and two-digit multiplier decomposition.
Independent reviewer enumerated 720 generated problems: exact products and at least one valid solution within the shot cap for every sample.
Reviewer real inputs verified partial shot, reset cost, overflow and undo state transitions; peer evidence includes all nine gates completed using real inputs.
Legible target and remaining quantity, visible shot limits, responsive tablet/desktop layout.

must_fix.issue: Reset silently consumes one repair life; no pre-action label describes that cost. Reviewer reproduced lives 5 to 4 after clicking 다시 쌓기.
must_fix.how: Make the repair cost visible before action, e.g. 다시 쌓기 · 수리 1.

must_fix.issue: Tutorial says undo the previous shot, but overflow shots are not in f.hits: after an overflow it restores the older successful shot and does not refund the life.
must_fix.how: Say the last successfully delivered blocks can be recalled once; overflow repair cost stays.

must_fix.issue: Three tutorial pages explain controls with text but do not visibly point at the actual target/charge/group controls.
must_fix.how: Highlight the real target or loader for the corresponding page.

nice_to_have: Stronger terrain, material depth and distinct fortress silhouettes: current playfield is clean but sparse and flat.
More strategic variety after learning each decomposition pattern; the three-target loop repeats with few physical choices beyond amount selection.
Ensure ledger/recovery text remains fully visible at 1280x800 and 820x1180: peer evidence recorded workbench bottom at 831/1211, beyond viewport.

evidence.first_play: Clicked start and tutorial pages; selected 20 and 3 to deliver 60 toward 72.
evidence.second_play: Reset fort, delivered 60, deliberately overflowed by delivering 100 toward 12, then undo recalled the previous 60 and did not refund overflow repair life.
evidence.limitations: Title art pending, final QA and full catalogue visual comparison not completed by this independent reviewer. Provisional score is deliberately not inflated to cross 80.

verdict: 수정 권고. 수학 또는 막힌 승리 경로는 발견하지 못했으나 숨은 초기화 비용을 표시해야 한다. 시각적 완성도와 전술 다양성은 상용 대표작 수준에 미달하며 77점으로 평가한다. 사용자의 80점 미만 배포 허용 여부는 호스트가 반영한다.
